resources.string: 1. Nothing for updates: Google Play updates this app.
2. A request for each wallpaper or live loop you choose to download. Core Builds Glyphs Pack comes from its own Google Play listing.

3. When you press an app under Missing icons: its name and component, and this TV\'s model, Android version and pack version, so the request can be filed. With Plus, also its Google Play purchase token, which is checked with Google and never stored or filed.
Google Play updates this app. Press to open its listing.
One purchase that marks your icon requests priority.
Plus is a one-time purchase through Google Play. Every app you press under Missing icons is filed as a priority request, and priority requests are drawn first.
Optional. Every icon, wallpaper and screen ships to everyone; Plus changes the order requests are done in, nothing else.
Price and payment come from Google Play. Core Builds never sees your card or your Google account.
